When Pompon feels that nothing is going right for him, Dadaidh shows him a way to sort things out! Pompon - Lana Beaton Rita/Tia - Mischa Macpherson Seòras - Calum MacKinnon Siùsaidh - Rebecca MacLennan Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc:
Tha Sionnach brònach nuair a chì e gun fheàrr le Maigheach a bhith a’ leughadh leabhar seach a bhith còmhla ris-san. Tha Tosg a’ moladh dhà e fhèin a chur ann an riochd ridire gaisgeil airson aire Maighich fhaighinn air ais. Tha an dithis aca a’ togail dràgon leis a’ bheachd gum faigh Sionnach buaidh air an dràgon, agus gun dearbh e a luach do Mhaigheach.
When Hare would rather read her big book of fairytales than hang out with Fox, he fears he’s not exciting enough. According to Tusk, only by becoming a brave knight will Fox be able to prove the opposite is true. The two decide to build a dragon so Fox can beat it in battle and prove his worth to Hare. Director - Linda MacLeod Production Company - Solus Productions.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.sub-title: Sgrùdadh Slàinte ║ S1E4/26. The Check-Up ║ S1E4/26
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag air a chlisgeadh mun sgrùdadh slàinte aige. Mr Krabs is too scared to get his physical.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc:
Ged a tha na saor-làithean air tòiseachadh do sgoilearan Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, tha latha a bharrachd aig an luchd-teagaisg airson beagan trèanaidh. Tha an t-eòlaiche-inntinn Sìleas Stern os cionn sheiseanan gus sìth agus càirdeas a stèidheachadh am measg an luchd-obrach.
Although the holidays have started for the pupils of Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, the teachers have an in-service day. Mr Mackle is keen to establish better relationships between his staff and has invited psychologist Sìleas Stern to run team building sessions that he hopes will bring peace and harmony.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Comhlan
programme.desc:
Tha Calum airson a chòmhlann aige a thoirt à Glaschu dhan Òban airson blàr mòr ciùil a tha dol aig a' Mhòd Nàiseanta Rìoghail. Ach, le tòrr fharpaisean agus gainead tìde, chan eil cùisean a' dol mar bu chòir. Leis nach eil e furasda còmhlan a làimhseachadh aig na h-amannan as fheàrr, saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh leis na dùbhlain mhòra a th' air thoiseach orra...
Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead? Director - Donald Ewen MacKinnon Executive Producer - Bill MacLeod.

programme.title: Oidhche Shamhna CBBC ALBA
programme.desc:
Tanith Rothach le taghadh a tha eagalach fhèin math airson Oidhche Shamhna, le slaidhm, braimeannan agus taibhse no dhà cuideachd!
Tanith Munro introduces some frighteningly good highlights for Halloween, with slime, farts and a ghost or two!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke – An Còcaire Fiadhain – a’ rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a’ coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a’ trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Tha Màiri Anna is Liusaidh a’ giollachd dhuircean daraich airson flùr a dhèanamh dhiubh, tha iad a’ lorg balagan fiaclach ann an Loch Aills, agus tha iad a’ dèanamh air Ceann a’ Ghiùthsaich air thòir air measan cùbhraidh nan aiteann. Agus tha iad a’ gabhail cuairt a dh’Eilean Èisdeil, feuch an trus iad sìol milis, blasta Lus nam Buadh agus far a bheil iad a’ beachdachadh air deifir bhuill de theaghlach phlanntrais nan curran.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke – The Wild Cooke – forage for nature’s bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc:
Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh.
The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Narrator - Kirsty Macdonald Producer - Andy Mackinnon Production Manager - Eilidh Johnson Executive Producer - Margaret Cameron.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc:
Angus Mackay is joined by close friend Finlay Macleod from Scalpay for the final fishing trip of the season. With summer fading, the environment looks very different as the purple heather really comes to the fore.
Tracked by the golden eagle, they sail north to the hamlet of Calbost to take advantage of the shelter offered by its bay on a less than optimal day. As the duo fish in the bay, they ponder the extremes of the sea - its matchless beauty and its mortal danger.
Anns a’ phrògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha Fionnlagh MacLeòid à Sgalpaigh, còmhla ri Aonghas airson an turas iasgaich mu dheireadh den t-seusan. Leis an samhradh a’ tighinn gu crìoch, tha an àrainneachd a’ coimhead gu math eadar-dhealaichte, ‘s am fraoch purpaidh a’ tighinn am follais. Air an leantainn le iolaire-bhuidhe, seòlaidh iad gu tuath, gu Calbost gus beagan fasgadh fhaighinn sa bhàgh, air latha meadhanach grod. Fhad ’s a tha iad ag iasgach, tha iad a’ meòrachadh air an dà chuid cunnart agus bòidhchead na mara.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc:
Highlights and previously unseen performances, featuring Mairi McGillivary, Ciaran Ryan and Fara.
Roghainn fon sreath ciùil comhla ri Màiri Nicillebhrath, Ciaran Ryan and Fara. Presenter - Mary Ann Kennedy Executive Producer - Alasdair MacCuish Director - John Smith Producer - Iain Macleod.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc:
Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee, with guest Calum Alex MacMillan.
Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Calum Ailig MacMhaolain.
In Gaelic with English subtitles Presenter - Cathy-Ann MacPhee.

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra na h-Alba
programme.desc:
Green-fingered Murdo Macdonald visits some of the country’s most important gardens to explore their design, plant-life, setting and history.
Murdo is in Ardkinglas on the banks of Loch Fyne in Argyll. In the House Gardens, he finds out about the model railway that used to run along the lochside, and wanders around the azaleas which are bursting with colour in the Ladies’ Garden. He walks up to the Old Mill by the river, then explores the champion trees and rhododendron collection in the Woodland Garden.
Roddy Maclean talks about the folklore associated with bluebells and Dr Mark Newman from the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh tells us more about the process of hybridising rhododendrons.
Tha gàirneilear sgileil, Murchadh Dòmhnallach, a’ tadhal air cuid de ghàrraidhean mòra na h-Alba, a’coimhead air an cruth, na tha fàs unnta agus an eachdraidh.
Sa phrògram seo tha Murchadh a’tadhal air Àrd Chonghlais air bruach Loch Fìne ann an Earra-Ghaidheal. Ann an Gàrradh an Taighe cluinnidh e mun mheanbh-rèile a b’àbhaist a bhi ruith ri taobh an locha, agus gabhaidh e cuairt a-measg a h-uile dath azalea ann an Gàrradh nam Ban. Ruigidh e an t-Seann Mhuilleann ri taobh na h-aibhne, mus tèid e choimhead nan sàr-chraobh agus na rhododendron ann an Gàrradh na Coille.
Bruidhnidh Ruairidh MacIlleathain air a’bheul-aithris timchioll air bròg-na-cuthaige, agus cluinnidh sinn barrachd bhon Oll. Mark Newman bho Ghàrradh Luibheanach Rìoghail Dhùn-Èidinn, mu tar-ghineadh nan rhododendron.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Murdo Macdonald Producer - Julie McCrone.

programme.title: Dàna
Scotland's Wild Side
programme.sub-title: Am Monadh Ruadh/Cairngorms ║ Dàna. S3. ALBAE2/4
programme.desc:
The vast landscape of the Cairngorms attracts thousands each year. Coinneach Rankin sets out on a multi-day expedition to learn why its vast mountains are a paradise for climbers, runners and so many others. Along with his partner, Coinneach races up one of the highest mountains in Scotland, undertakes a classic multi-pitch climb, and spends the night in a tiny bothy built in the 1960s.
Tàlaidh cruth-tìre aibheiseach a’ Mhonaidh Ruaidh na mìltean gach bliadhna. Cuiridh Coinneach MacFhraing aghaidh air turas grunn làithean gus tuigsinn carson a tha sreapadairean, luchd-coise agus eile cho measail air na beanntan seo.
An cuideachd deagh charaid, thèid Coinneach na dheann suas tè de na beanntan as àirde an Alba, dìreidh e slighe-sreapa fhada agus cuiridh e seachad na h-oidhche ann am bothan a thogadh ‘sna seasgadan.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Coinneach Rankin Executive Producer - Tony Kearney Executive Producer - Jim Webster Executive Producer - Calum McConnell Director - Hamish MacLeod.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc:
Ramsay meets Ian Smith in the village he was brought up, before they head along one of Tiree’s most famous beaches. As they walk along the coast, Ian reflects on his youth and the people that impacted him.
Ian discusses how the Tiree music scene shaped him and brought him success as a box player, and he shares his passion for the island and his pride in setting up the only distillery in Tiree.
San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha.
Coinnichidh Ramsay ri Iain Mac a’ Ghobhainn sa bhaile san d’rugadh e mas dèan iad air tè de na tràighean as iomraitiche ann an Tiriodh. Meòirichidh Iain air làithean òige agus na daoine bu mhotha a thug buaidh air a bheatha.
Leis cho cudromach ‘s a tha ceòl air eilean Thiriodh, innsidh Iain man bhuaidh a bh’aige seo air fhèin agus mar a chuidich e a bhith cho soirbheachail le cluich a’ bhogsa. Bidh an dà chuid a mheas air an eilean agus a mhoit man aon taigh-stàile san eilean fhaighinn stèidhichte follaiseach.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Ramsay MacMahon Series Producer - Robyn Low Editor - Mairead Morrison.

programme.title: Ceol Sith
programme.desc:
Thigibh air turas a-steach gu saoghal shìthichean agus creutairean os-nadarra eile. Air chuairt ann an Alba, tha Ingrid NicEunraig a’ cluinntinn beul-aithris agus sgeulachdan a tha fhathast beo. Anns a’ program sònraichte seo, tha Ingrid a’ tòiseachadh ann an Loch Abar far a bheil mòran stòraidhean mar seo air maireachdainn.
As dèidh sin tha I a’ cluinntinn sgeulachdan nas tradisteanta anns an Eilean Sgiathanach. Tha I cuideachd a’ cluinntinn sgeulachd bhampire ann an Glaschu agus mu bheathaichean bhon uisge ann an Uibhist, mu maighidinn-mara agus each-uisge. Tha a cuid-siubhal ga brosnachach gus ceòl ùr a sgriobhadh agus a chluich ann an cuid de na h-àiteachan as drùidhteach san dùthaich. Air aon làimh ’s eeàlachas a th’anns a’ phrògram seo ach aig an aon àm, tha e a’ toirt dhuinn sealladh air spiorad mac an duine.
This is a thrilling journey into the world of fairies and folklore. Ingrid Henderson presents a tour around Scotland’s rich mythical worlds and composes music to bring them back to life.
Ingrid starts on her home turf in Lochaber, where these stories are very much alive, and then heads to Skye with its traditional fairy stories. She also hears about a terrifying creature in Glasgow - the Gorbals vampire - and talks to people in Uist about watery creatures such as mermaids and kelpies.
As she travels, Ingrid draws inspiration from the stories to create and perform specially composed music for the programme in stunning locations around the country. On the one hand, this documentary is pure escapism, but it also gives us insight into the human spirit.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Ingrid Henderson Executive Producer - Maureen MacLeod Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - Annie Cheape.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc:
Air a togail san dàrna linn deug ann am meadhan Paris (air an Île de la Cité), aig aon àm b' e Notre-Dame a' chathair-eaglais a b' àirde air thalamh. Tha an t-soitheach aibhseach cloiche seo a' riochdachadh ailtireachd Gotach. Ach tha a seasmhachd a-nise ann an cunnart.
Rinn an teine milleadh air cothromachd an togalaich. Chaidh am mullach a sgrios, còmhla ris a' chliath iongantaich fiodha seo – air a dèanamh de mhìle craobh daraich – 's chaidh a losgadh san teine. Ach fhathast cha do thuit Notre-Dame. Dè as coireach gu bheil i cho làidir? Am measg an sprùillich chaidh iomadh ceangal meatailt a lorg, cuid de mheud iongantach. An robh iad nam pàirt dhen chiad dhealbhadh no nach robh? An gabhadh e a bhith gun do dh'fhuiling Notre-Dame trioblaidean structarail eile tro na linntean?
Leanaidh sinn gu dlùth an luchd-saidheans is na h-ailtirean is iad a' sgrùdadh a' chliath iongantach fiodha is meatailt a bh' air cùl na cloiche. Le cuideachadh bho dhealbhan 3D agus ath-achdachaidhean gheibh sinn tuigse air toiseach an togalaich mhòrail seo.
Built in the 12th century in the centre of Paris (on Île de la Cité), Notre-Dame was once the world's highest cathedral. This gigantic stone structure is the very essence of Gothic architecture. But today, its stability is compromised.
The 2019 fire greatly damaged the building's structure. Its roof was completely destroyed, as well as its incredible wooden frame, made of a thousand oaks, which was swallowed by the flames. Still, Notre-Dame did not collapse. What are the secrets of this exceptional strength? Amongst the wreckage, many metal fasteners were found, some of incredible size. Were they part of the original design or not? Is it possible that Notre-Dame encountered other structural problems throughout the centuries?
We closely follow scientists and architects as they study the impressive skeleton of wood and metal which hid behind the stone. Supported by 3D animations as well as re-enactments, their interventions allow us to grasp the genesis of this monumental structure.
Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles. Narrator - Anna Murray Producer - Seumas Mactaggart Executive Producer - Shona Henderson Executive Producer - Calum McConnell Editor - Innes Macleod.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.sub-title: Brot Coiridh le Leantail is Leigeas ║ AiganTaighleE6/12
programme.desc:
'S e th' ann am Brot fìor bhlast' de Choiridh leantail, ach lòn sònraicht' nach dìochuimhnich thu ann an cabhaig.
An extremely delicious curried lentil soup is a special lunch which you won't forget in a hurry.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Abigail Maciver Producer - Kenneth Stewart Production Manager - Mairi Macleod Executive Producer - Rachel Ellen Mackay.

programme.title: An Geam Àlainn
programme.desc:
Ball-coise nam ban ann an Alba bho shealladh luchd-cluiche, leithid an deugaire Osla, sgiobaidhean, leithid Caley Thistle Inbhir Nis agus sgioba WIIGA, luchd-leantainn & eòlaichean. Nì am prògram aithriseach foillseachadh cuid de na sgeulachdan iongantach a tha a’ nochdadh agus mar a tha a’ gheama a sìor dhol am meud airson cluicheadairean an latha an-duigh. Le agallamhan bho luchd-leantainn mar Màiri Anna Chaimbeul, Seòna Nic’Ill’Fhionndaig agus an sgrìobhaiche-spòrs Ailig O’Henley. Coinnichidh sinn ri feadhainn eile a thug buaidh air an spòrs, leithid an dithis a stèidhich Glasgow City F.C. , Laura Montgomery and Carol Anne Stewart, agus Fiona McIntyre, ceannard an SWPL, a bha mar mheadhan air cruth a chur air structar a’ gheama a tha againn an-diugh. Catrìona NicNèill ag aithris.
Women’s football in Scotland seen through the eyes of players, including teenager Osla; teams including Inverness Caledonian Thistle and the WIIGA squad, as well as fans and experts. The documentary reveals some of the extraordinary stories within the game and how it has evolved for the players of today, with contributions from fans Mary Ann Campbell, Seona McClintock and sportswriter Alex O’Henley.
We also meet influential figures such as Glasgow City FC founders Laura Montgomery and Carol Anne Stewart, and SWPL chief Fiona McIntyre, who were instrumental in shaping football’s modern framework. Narrated by Carrie MacNeil.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Narrator - Carrie MacNeil Executive Producer - Alasdair MacCuish Director - Iain Macleod Producer - Ewan Duncan Production Manager - Gillian MacLean.

programme.title: Na Trads
programme.desc:
Na Trads: An Dara Teud. Roghainn bho oidhche mhòr duaisean Na Trads 2023, a tighinn à Talla Caird, Dùn Dè. Le Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Alistair Heather air an àrd-ùrlar agus air cùl stèids, coinneachaidh sin ris na luchd-ciùil agus na rionnagan a shoirbhich air an oidhche. Am measg na bhios a’ gabhail pàirt bidh Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth agus an Robbie Shepherd Tribute.
Highlights and music from the Trad Awards, from the Caird Hall, Dundee. Presenters Mary Ann Kennedy and Alistair Heather host the evening and we catch up with winners and stars of the event, both onstage and behind the scenes. Performances from Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth and a musical tribute to a national treasure - the late Robbie Shepherd. Presenter - Mary Ann Kennedy Presenter - Alistair Heather.

programme.title: Losgannan
Froglets
programme.sub-title: Banrigh Pipp ║ Losgannan. S1E22/26. Queen Pipp ║ Losgannan. S1E22/26
programme.desc:
Le taic bho chàch, tha Pipp a’ dol na banrigh, le crùn, cathair agus parèid rìoghail.
With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with crown, throne and royal parade.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Tha Meanbh is Beag ag adhbharachadh tubaist a tha a’ gabhail a-steach dìtheanan bulgach, am Moo-adhair, agus a’ Chearc Iarainn. Ciamar a thèid cùisean a cheartachadh?
Meanbh and Beag cause an accident which involves bubble flowers, the Sky-Moo and the Iron Chicken. How will they get things sorted? Narrator - Iain Mackinnon Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed Writer - Alec MacDonald.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Tha Beag tro chèile oir cha d' fhuair e air na solais iongantach fhaicinn nuair a bha e a-muigh ’g iasgach san long-chiùil. Dè nì Am Màidsear airson togail a thoirt do Bheag?
Beag is upset when he misses seeing two spectacular lights whilst out fishing in the music boat. What will Am Màidsear do to cheer Small up? Narrator - Iain Mackinnon Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed Writer - Alec MacDonald.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc:
Tha Baba a' coinneachadh ri a charaid, Spiky, ach, chan eil Spiky airson cluich an-diugh - tha e troimh chèile 's e air a mhàthair a chall. Tha Baba cur roimhe Spiky a chuideachadh 's tha an dithis aca a' togail orra air turas-dàna!
Baba is excited to meet his new friend Spiky, but Spiky doesn't want to play today as he has lost his mother and is very upset. Baba is determined to help and so the pair set off on an adventure to find her!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc:
Tha Oona 's Silky a' cur romhpa snàmh cuide ri na leumadairean ach tha Silky bochd a' tighinn an aghaidh creutair neònach a tha a' cur an dearg eagal orra! Tha an dithis a' dol gu Bernie gus faighinn a-mach dè seòrsa beathach a dh'fhaodadh a bhith ann.
Oona and Sily's plan to spend the day swimming with dolphins is brought to a halt when a strange creature scares poor Silky witless. The pair visit Bernie to learn who, or what, this creature could possibly be.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Bing a’ cluich geama le fòn-làimhe Flop, chaneil rudan a’ dol mar bu chòir oir tha am fòn-làimhe a' briseadh nuair a tha e dol na sgeing air an làr. An àite seo innse do Flop, tha Bing ga chuir dhan bhiona. Tha e faireachdainn cho dona mun seo ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gum feum e innse mar a thachair.
When Bing is playing a game with Flop’s mobile phone, he accidentally drops the mobile and it breaks. Instead of telling Flop, he throws it in the bin. programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc:
Tha Rob MacNeacail air turas gus sailm Ghàidhlig a sheinn is a sgaoileadh. ’S e film tarraingeach is togarrach a tha seo mu chumhachd na coimhearsnachd, an teaghlaich is an seasmhachd a tha a dhìth gus cànan a chumail beò.
Thòisich Rob air na sailm a ghabhail ann an Carlops gus comharrachadh ceann-bliadhna bàs athar, am bàrd Aonghas MacNeacail. Ged a tha na seiseanan a’ còrdadh ri muinntir a’ bhaile, tha Rob ga cheasnachadh fhèin a bheil còir aige a bhith a’ teagasg nan salm. Cha do dh’ionnsaich e mar a stiùireas e an t-seinn ach o chionn ghoirid, agus cha deach a thogail san eaglais. Chan eil Rob aig tàmh is e a’ faireachdainn gum feum e falbh air turas gus cluinntinn mar a bhios na Gàidheil a’ seinn nan salm anns na coimhearsnachdan a tha a’ cumail an traidisein beò.
Bheir an turas e bho na h-Eileanan an Iar gu Corcaigh an Iar, a’ leantainn seann shlighean a bheireas ceòl is beachdan ùra gu bith.
Rob MacNeacail embarks on a mission to sing Gaelic psalms. An entertaining and heartwarming film about the power of community, family and the resilience needed to keep a language alive.
Rob started singing the psalms in his home village of Carlops to mark the anniversary of the death of his father, the poet Aonghas MacNeacail. Although the sessions are popular with locals, Rob starts to question his authority to teach the psalms, as he only learned how to precent relatively recently and didn’t grow up in the church.
As spring turns to summer, Rob starts to feel restless and decides to hit the road to reconnect with his Gaelic roots and hear how psalms are sung by Gaels in the communities that nurture the tradition. His journey takes him from the Western Isles to West Cork in Ireland, following well-trodden ancient paths that unravel threads of music and ideas along the way.
In Gaelic with English subtitles Director - Jack Archer Executive Producer - John Archer Editor - James Alcock Executive Producer - Calum McConnell Production Manager - Mhairi Valentine Production Company - Hopscotch Films.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc:
In the Highlands and Islands, Calum explores the caves of Assynt, a Unesco global geopark, before travelling north to Orkney where there is a wealth of archeological underground sites. But it is also an example of the modern use of subterranean sites: oil to service the Scapa Flow naval sites was hidden underground in vast tanks beneath Wee Fea hill. The war theme continues as Calum visits a Cold War underground bunker in Inverness.
Anns a’ Ghàidhealtachd agus na h-Eileanan, bheir Calum cuairt tro uamhan Asainte, geò-pàirc cruinneil UNESCO. À sin, thèid e tuath gu Arcaibh far a bheil beartas de làraich arceòlach fon talamh, ach cuideachd eisimpleir nas ùire den fho-thalamh a chleachdadh. Fo chnoc Wee Fea, tha na tancaichean mòra a bha a’ cumail ola ri làrach a’ Chabhlaich Rìoghail ann an Scapa Flow. A’ cumail ri tèama a’ chogaidh, ann an Inbhirnis tadhlaidh Calum air buncair bho àm a’ Chogaidh Fhuair.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke – An Còcaire Fiadhain – a’ rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a’ coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a’ trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Tha Màiri Anna is Liusaidh a’ giollachd dhuircean daraich airson flùr a dhèanamh dhiubh, tha iad a’ lorg balagan fiaclach ann an Loch Aills, agus tha iad a’ dèanamh air Ceann a’ Ghiùthsaich air thòir air measan cùbhraidh nan aiteann. Agus tha iad a’ gabhail cuairt a dh’Eilean Èisdeil, feuch an trus iad sìol milis, blasta Lus nam Buadh agus far a bheil iad a’ beachdachadh air deifir bhuill de theaghlach phlanntrais nan curran.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke – The Wild Cooke – forage for nature’s bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ceol Sith
programme.desc:
Thigibh air turas a-steach gu saoghal shìthichean agus creutairean os-nadarra eile. Air chuairt ann an Alba, tha Ingrid NicEunraig a’ cluinntinn beul-aithris agus sgeulachdan a tha fhathast beo. Anns a’ program sònraichte seo, tha Ingrid a’ tòiseachadh ann an Loch Abar far a bheil mòran stòraidhean mar seo air maireachdainn.
As dèidh sin tha I a’ cluinntinn sgeulachdan nas tradisteanta anns an Eilean Sgiathanach. Tha I cuideachd a’ cluinntinn sgeulachd bhampire ann an Glaschu agus mu bheathaichean bhon uisge ann an Uibhist, mu maighidinn-mara agus each-uisge. Tha a cuid-siubhal ga brosnachach gus ceòl ùr a sgriobhadh agus a chluich ann an cuid de na h-àiteachan as drùidhteach san dùthaich. Air aon làimh ’s eeàlachas a th’anns a’ phrògram seo ach aig an aon àm, tha e a’ toirt dhuinn sealladh air spiorad mac an duine.
This is a thrilling journey into the world of fairies and folklore. Ingrid Henderson presents a tour around Scotland’s rich mythical worlds and composes music to bring them back to life.
Ingrid starts on her home turf in Lochaber, where these stories are very much alive, and then heads to Skye with its traditional fairy stories. She also hears about a terrifying creature in Glasgow - the Gorbals vampire - and talks to people in Uist about watery creatures such as mermaids and kelpies.
As she travels, Ingrid draws inspiration from the stories to create and perform specially composed music for the programme in stunning locations around the country. On the one hand, this documentary is pure escapism, but it also gives us insight into the human spirit.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Ingrid Henderson Executive Producer - Maureen MacLeod Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - Annie Cheape.

Troig/Rìgh - Iain Macrae Bonns - Mischa Macpherson Uilidh/Seonaidh - Lana Beaton Snorg - Derek MacIntosh Glob - Calum MacKinnon Chank - Ruaraidh Munro Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Editor - Phil Reed Producer - Mairi Macleod.

Troig/Rìgh - Iain Macrae Bonns/Merri - Mischa Macpherson Uilidh - Lana Beaton Dùd/Snorg - Derek MacIntosh Glob - Calum MacKinnon Chank - Ruaraidh Munro Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Editor - Phil Reed Producer - Mairi Macleod.

programme.title: Golf: Mun Cuairt Alba
programme.desc:
Le còrr air 550 raon-goilf tha Alba cliùiteach mar dhachaigh ghoilf. Tha an sreath 6-pàirt seo a’ gabhail turas air feadh na dùthcha gu na cùrsaichean ainmeil agus na seudan àlainn nach eil cho iomraiteach, a’ fosgladh ar sùilean gu goilf. Cluinnidh sinn bho ghoilfearan sean is òg, fireann is boireann, goilfearan dall is goilfearan ciorramach, agus bho chuid a bhios a' cosnadh beòshlaint à goilf.
An t-seachdain-sa, gabhaidh sinn sgrìob-adhair mu chuairt taghadh de raointean-goilf anns na h- Eileanan an Iar, cluinnidh sinn mu eachdraidh Aisgeirnis ann an Uibhist a Deas, tha Stuart Griffin is Hugh Ross a’ cluich goilf le aon ghàirdean agus cluinnidh sinn an sgeòil aig Club Goilf Shruighlea. Agus tha coidse proifeiseanta Keil Beveridge a’ toirt seachad comhairle na seachdaine airson dòigh-cluiche.
Scotland has over 550 golf courses and is regarded worldwide as the home of golf. This series takes us on a journey around the country to explore some of the well-known courses as well as some of its hidden gems, and opens the door to golf. We hear from golfers young and old, male and female, blind and disabled, and from those who make their living working in golf. We also capture a few tips from the professionals along the way.
In this episode, we take an aerial journey around a selection of golf courses in the Western Isles. We learn about the story of the historic golf course at Askernish in South Uist.
Stuart Griffin and Hugh Ross are one-armed golfers who compete internationally. We catch up with them playing at Stirling Golf Club. And professional coach Keil Beveridge demonstrates his weekly top playing tip.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Expert - Keil Beveridge Expert - Laura Murray Producer - Patricia Macleod Director - Scott Brown Editor - Jonny Craigmile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.sub-title: An Aimsir ║ S1(A1)E3/13. The Weather ║ S1(A1)E3/13
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na ciad ceumannan a tha a dhìth airson ar misneachadh gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Thairis air an t-sreath, bidh i a’ dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh’ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas mu charaidean, an dachaigh, an teaghlach, obair agus an aimsir am measg gu leòr eile ann an dòigh a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a’ cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir ann an dramathan goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn luchd-ionnsachaidh èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr agus cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh, agus iadsan a th’ air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a’ toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne: www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan a tha ri fhaighinn air BBC Sounds.
We meet Gaelic learner Ben Geyer from Fife and Calum Maclean is in St Monans, finding out about the prosperity white gold brought to the area.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds. Presenter - Joy Dunlop Presenter - Calum Maclean Executive Producer - Una McDonald Producer - Colin MacLeod.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc:
Seo an fharpais-cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Le Niall Iain Dòmnallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha Ewen is Jonny agus Marley is Denise.
Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions! Battling the Pretenders to win the big prize in the studio are Ewen and Jonny, and Marley and Denise.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Eòrpa
programme.desc:
Le ball-coise ann an Alba ann an staing le gainnead chluicheadairean òga a’ faighinn chothroman, tha an SFA airson crathadh a thoirt air na riaghailtean aca. Tha Calum MacIllinnein a’ rannsachadh nam planaichean, a’ coinneachadh ri clubaichean, cluicheadairean is luchd-leantainn, is a’ faighneachd dè thèid again air ionnsachadh bho shiostam Nirribhidh.
As Scottish football faces a crisis over its pipeline of talent, the SFA are planning an overhaul of youth development. Calum Maclennan examines the plans, meeting clubs, players and fans, and asks what we can learn from Norway’s system.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.sub-title: Clann a’ Mhansa An La An-De/Children of the Manse ║ S14E8/10
programme.desc:
’S e dreuchd gu math sònraichte a th’ aig ministear agus bha seo fìor gu h-àraidh anns na 60an agus na 70an. Duine foghlamaichte, anns an robh earbsa aig daoine ’s aig an robh seasamh làidir anns a’ choimhearsnachd. Ach an dùil cò ris a bha e coltach nam b’ e d’ athair a bha a’ searmonachadh anns a’ chubainn?
Tha an craoladair Cathy Nicdhòmhnaill a’ bruidhinn ri clann a’ mhansa an là an-dè, a chaidh an togail aig àm an uair a bha buaidh mhòr aig an eaglais. Tha i a’ bruidhinn ris an Urramach Iomhair Màrtainn, fear a lean ann an ceumannan athar agus a tha a-nis na mhodaràtair air Eaglais Shaor na h-Alba.
Tha i a’ faighinn facal air Jessie Mary Little, nighean an Urramaich Aonghas Mac a’ Ghobhainn, am ministear a chaidh an aghaidh bàtaichean-aiseig na Sàbaid ann an 1965, agus tha i cuideachd a’ còmhradh ri Dòmhnall Iain MacAmhlaigh, mac an urramaich Murchadh MacAmhlaigh, a tha a’ mìneachadh mar a thug creideamh buaidh làidir air a bheatha fhèin, am measg cuid eile, is iad uile ag innse sgeulachdan mu am pàrantan agus mu sheirbheisean ’s na h-òrdaighean, a’ dèanamh dealbh math de na sgìrean eaglais anns an deach an togail. A’ coimhead air ais, ciamar a tha seo air buaidh a thoirt air mar tha iad fhèin a’ coimhead air an t-saoghal?
A minister's important role was much to the fore in the 60s and 70s. A person whom people trusted, who was knowledgeable and well-educated, and who held a strong position in the community. But what was life like if your father was the one preaching in the pulpit?
Broadcaster Cathy Macdonald talks to sons and daughters of the manse, who were brought up during a time when the church had far reaching influence. She speaks to the Rev Iver Martin, who followed in his father’s footsteps and became a minister, and who is now the Moderator of the Free Church of Scotland.
Cathy chats with Jessie Mary Little, daughter of Rev Angus Smith, the well-known minister who protested against Sunday sailings in 1965 and she also talks to Donald John MacAulay, son of the Rev Murdo MacAulay, who describes how faith has had a strong influence on his life. They all share warm-hearted stories about their parents, church services and the camaraderie of communions, creating a portrait of the parishes in which they grew up.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.sub-title: Meal do Naidheachd An-Diugh - Happy Birthday ║ S1E1/6
programme.desc:
It’s make or break time at the Hebridean family-run tweed mill, ‘Muileann Mhicsuain’. Time is running out for mill owner Seumas as he tries to save his business, but his corner-cutting has horrific consequences.
A dreadful accident takes place on the mill floor that endangers the life of a beloved employee, Old Mary. With the family business in jeopardy, Seumas makes a secret phone call asking for help, but who is he reaching out to and why does he have to keep it secret from his family?
Tha taghaidhean mòra air thoiseach orra aig Muileann MhicSuain, a’ mhuileann chlò Innse Gall a th’ air a ruith le teaghlach MhicSuain. Tha an ùine a’ ruith air ceannard na muilne, Seumas, agus e a’ dèanamh nas urrainn dhà gus a’ ghnìomhachas aige a shàbhaileadh – ach tha cùisean a’ tighinn gu ceann uabhasach ri linn an dòigh-obrach charach aige. Tha tubaist eagalach a’ tachairt air làr na muilne a tha a’ cur beatha tè dhen luchd-obrach, Màiri, ann an cunnart. Le gnìomhachas an teaghlaich fo imcheist, tha Seumas a’ cur a dh’iarraidh cuideachadh – ach cò dhà a tha e a’ faighneachd agus carson a dh’fheumas e a chumail bhon chòrr dhen teaghlach?
In Gaelic with English subtitles Seumas - Ewen MacKinnon Sileas - Erica Morrison Donald - Eoghan MacDonald Murdina - Emma MacLeod Mairead - Anna Murray Production Manager - Mairi MacKinnon Executive Producer - Jim Webster Executive Producer - Tony Kearney.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc:
’S caomh leinn a bhith smaoineachadh gu bheil eòlas againn air an t-saoghal timcheall oirnn, ach dè ma tha sinn dìreach a’ faicinn pàirt dheth? Tha Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean a’ toirt cuireadh dhuinn coiseachd, snàmh agus leum am measg nam beathaichean agus an saoghal aca a thuigsinn nan àrainneachd fhèin.
Thairis air ceithir eapasodan iongantach, tha sinn ag ionnsachadh mu chiad-fàthan cumhachdach nam beathaichean, bho fradharc buileach mionaideach gu iasg a tha a’ blasad len craiceann. Faic mar a tha tìgearan gan cleith fhèin le bhith a’ cleachdadh an dath orains, mar a tha leumadairean a’ seòladh a’ chuain le echo-location, mathain-nighe a’ dèanamh an slighe le spògan air leth faireachail, agus tha fiù ’s craobhan a’ cur a-mach rabhaidhean ceimigeach.
Tha Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean a’ taisbeanadh taobhan falaichte de nàdar - cailèideascop de chiad-fàthan nach eil sinn ach air tòiseachadh a’ tuigsinn.
We like to think we know the world around us, but what if we’re only seeing part of the picture? This is an invitation for you to walk, swim, or leap in someone else’s paws, fins, or wings - and experience life from a wild perspective.
Across the series, we uncover animal super-senses, from high-resolution vision to fish that taste with their skin. Discover how tigers turn orange into camouflage, dolphins navigate the deep using echo-location, raccoons feel their way with hyper-sensitive paws, and even trees send out chemical alarms.
Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles Narrator - Annella MacLeod Executive Producer - Alasdair Fraser Producer - Seumas Mactaggart Editor - Innes Macleod.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc:
Skipinnish le The Atholl Set ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann.
Skipinnish perform The Atholl Set in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle. Musician - Angus Macphail Executive Producer - Alasdair McCuish Production Manager - Gillian MacLean.

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc:
Nuair tha Boban is Fuigheag a’ lorg spong copach, abair g’ eil spòrs aca leis na builgeanan beaga – tha Fuigheag dìreach na ghlòraidh. Ach uaireannan, feumar a cheannsachadh!
When Boban and Fuigheag find a soapy sponge, they have a lot of fun with the little bubbles. Fuigheag is in his element, but sometimes he needs to calm down! Narrator - Kathleen MacInnes Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed Writer - Alec MacDonald.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc:
Nuair a chì Sionnach mar a tha Feòrag air a beò-ghlacadh le na saor-làithean mìorbhaileach aice anns a’ choille, tha e fhèin airson a dhol air saor-làithean. Chan eil Maigheach cho cinnteach mun chùis. Cò choimheadas às dèidh a’ bhothain agus a’ ghàrraidh? Cò ach Tosg is Comhachag! Carson nach rachadh an dithis aca-san air saor-làithean mìorbhaileach anns a’ bhothan? Saoil dè cho mìorbhaileach ’s a bhios na saor-làithean aca uile?
Brush really enjoys her holiday in the forest, which makes Fox want to go on one as well! Hare isn’t so sure - who will take care of their den and garden? Well, Tusk and Owl of course! Fox and Hare convince them to stay in their den and have a good break, too. Will everybody’s holiday turn out as 'wonnnnderful' as they hope? Director - Linda MacLeod Production Company - Solus Productions.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc:
Tha Rita agus Pompon airson fàilte bhlàth a thoirt do Shìthiche nam Fiaclan ach, gu mì-fhortanach, nuair a tha Pompon a' dùsgadh, chan eil ach aon phrèasant ri fhaicinn. Saoil cò gheibh am prèasant?
Rita and Pompon want to welcome the Tooth Fairy but, unfortunately, when Pompon wakes up, only one present has been left. Who do you think gets the present? Pompon - Lana Beaton Rita - Mischa Macpherson Seòras - Calum MacKinnon Siùsaidh - Rebecca MacLennan Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc:
An-diugh, tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean a’ coinneachadh ri losgann is cinn-pholla bheaga.
Today, Ladybird and Bee meet a frog and some small tadpoles. Ladybird - Emily Davidson Narrator/Bee - Rachel Kate Macleod Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed Writer - Alec MacDonald.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc:
Tha a h-uile duine air an sàrachadh is cùisean cho dòrainneach. Tha Àtaidh a’ togail trèana airson is gun urrainn dhaibh uile a dhol air turas. An uair sin tha beachd aig Tilidh, is tha i a’ moladh gun tèid iad uile air turas timcheall an eilein air fad. ’S e turas air leth a th’ ann, gus an tig rudeigin nan rathad!
Everybody is bored. Abney builds a train so they can go on a tour. Then Teal has an idea: why don’t they tour the whole island? It is a fantastic tour until something gets in the way! Teal - Linda MacLeod Abney - Tony Kearney Producer - Linda MacLeod Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Editor - Chas Chalmers Production Company - Solus Productions.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc:
When a penguin takes a shine to Stink's bed, and Grumblestunk decides to open a zoo, Brody is unimpressed, so Stan and Gran are forced to investigate!
Nuair a tha ceann-fionn a' gabhail nòisean den leabaidh aig Samh, 's tha Greannarlobht a' cur roimhpe sù fhosgladh, chan eil Murchadh air a dhòigh, 's le sin, chan eil roghainn aig Dan is Gran ach teannadh ri rannsachadh! Dan - Ellen Macdonald Gran - Kathleen MacInnes Seanair - Tom MacIver Greannarlobht - Maureen MacLeod Producer - Kenneth Stewart Production Manager - Mairi Macleod Executive Producer - Rachel Ellen Mackay.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.sub-title: Tha Gaol Agam Ort Mar-thà ║ S2E17/80
programme.desc:
Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Martainn Mac an t-Saoir a’ leughadh Tha Gaol Agam Ort Mar-thà! Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Jory John agus a dhealbhachadh le Benji Davies. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill.
A bedtime story for young children. Martin MacIntyre reads Tha Gaol Agam Ort Mar-thà! by Jory John, illustrated by Benji Davies and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald. Presenter - Martin MacIntyre.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc:
Aig Coinneamh nam Pàrant, tha Hilda ag ionnsachadh g’ eil creag bhon Chruinneachadh Nàdair aig Dàibhidh neo-àbhaisteach is, ri linn sin, tha 'd uile ann am fìor chunnart
At the parents’ meeting, Hilda learns that one of Daibhidh’s rocks from his nature collection is out of the ordinary. But it puts them all in great danger. Hilda - Mischa Macpherson Mum - Anna Murray Daibhidh (David) - Ellen MacDonald Flòraidh (Frida) - Lauren Macdonald Margie/Ms Hallgrim - Kathleen MacInnes Executive Producer - Bill MacLeod Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed Writer - Alec MacDonald.

programme.title: Stri
programme.desc:
Tha preasantairean CBBC ALBA uabhasach fhèin measail air dùbhlain ach saoil cò shoirbhicheas is Hannah a’ tadhal orra?
The CBBC ALBA presenters love a good challenge, but who will emerge victorious as Hannah joins them? Presenter - Calum MacDonald Presenter - Ellen Macdonald Executive Producer - Una MacDonald.

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Nidza a’ cluich ball-coise le charaidean, chan eil cùisean a’ dol mar bu chòir oir the e ga fhaighinn fhèin glaiste ann an seilear is dearg-eagal aige bhon dorchadas!
When Nidza plays football with his friends, things don’t go his way as he finds himself locked in a cellar and he’s petrified of the dark! Nidza - Patrick Maclean Stefan - Angus MacLeod Marko - Calum MacNeil Nephew/Waiter - Derek MacIntosh Woman - Floraidh Maclean Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart.

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc:
Bodach-sneachd, rabaid, curran, Coinneach Clogaid agus beagan draoidheachd – abair measgachadh!
Coinneach Clogaid, a rabbit, a carrot and a little magic - what a combination! Aithris - David Walker Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Editor - Phil Reed Writer - David Walker Writer - Alec MacDonald.

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc:
Càit’ an stad Coinneach Clogaid leis a dhroch-ghiùlain? Bheil càil idir ann nach fheuch e? Ge-tà, chaneil dòigh air thalamh gum faigh e às leis!
Where will Coinneach Clogaid stop with his bad behaviour? Is there anything that he won’t try? There is no way that he will get away with it though! Aithris - David Walker Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Editor - Phil Reed Writer - David Walker.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc:
Tha oidhche Shathairne tric a’ ciallachadh ‘takeaway’, ach tha na seòid a’ sealltainn dhuinn gun gabh biadh ‘chippy’ a dhèanamh aig an taigh cuideachd. Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh iasg blasta le taois-leanna fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh tiops air am bruich dà thuras. Tha Ùisdean an uairsin a’ dèanamh Scampi agus ‘Clampi” ann an taois tempura le tiops air am bruich trì tursan! Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Coleslaw a thèid còmhla ris agus cuideachd sabhs spìosrach. Gus crìoch a chur air a’ phrògram, tha Ùisdean a’ dèanamh donut reòiteig, le Ruairidh a’ dèanamh sabhs caramail airson a ghabhail còmhla ris.
Saturday nights often mean takeaway dinners, but the lads show us that excellent 'chippy' food can be made at home, too. Ruaridh cooks a tasty beer-battered fish while Uisdean prepares twice cooked chips to go with it. Uisdean then makes Scampi and 'Clampi' in tempura batter accompanied by thrice-cooked chips! Ruaridh creates a coleslaw and a spicy dipping sauce as an addition. Uisdean then makes an ice cream doughnut while Ruaridh cooks a caramel sauce to go with it.
In Gaelic with English subtitles Presenter - Uisdean Macleod Presenter - Roddy Munro Executive Producer - Ishbel Maclennan Production Manager - Mairi Macleod Producer - Kenneth Stewart.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a’ dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh’ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a’ cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-ionnsachaidh èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta ’s a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th’ air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a’ toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àiteachan air feadh na dùthcha.Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she’ll introduce words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work and communication.
We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. The intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds. Presenter - Joy Dunlop Executive Producer - Una MacDonald.

programme.desc:
Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA.
Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc:
Actress turned interior designer Erica Macpherson takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers, she finds new ideas for designing old spaces.
Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Erica Macpherson Editor - Paul Duke Director - Calum Angus Mackay Producer - Rachel Ellen Mackay.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc:
Calum explores the underground sites of central Scotland. First, author Mairi Kidd introduces him to a lesser known history of Edinburgh below the city streets. Then he ventures under the busy platforms of Glasgow Central Station, where Calum discovers an atmospheric disused Victorian platform.
In Dunoon, Calum gets help from his friend Kenny Rankin to access the Paper Caves and find out more about a story that dates back almost 350 years, connecting the Campbell clan with the site.
’S a’ phrògram mu dheireadh, nì Calum rannsachadh air làraich fon talamh ann am meadhan na h-Alba. Innsidh an t-ùghdair, Màiri Kidd, dha mun eachdraidh fo shràidean Dhùn Èideann air nach eil mòran eòlach. Fo àrd-ùrlairean trang Stèisean Rèile Meadhan Ghlaschu, gheibh Calum lorg air àrd-ùrlar iongantach, neo-chleachte bho linn Bhictòiria. Ann an Dùn Omhain, bheir a charaid, Coinneach MacFhraing, cuideachadh do Chalum gus Uamhan nam Pàipear a ruighinn agus tuilleadh ionnsachadh mu sgeulachd bhon t-seachdamh linn deug a tha a’ ceangal na Caimbeulaich ris an t-sreath uamhan seo.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Calum Maclean Director - David Martin Producer - Ann Morrison Executive Producer - Bill MacLeod Editor - Calum Blane Production Manager - Innes Maciver.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke – An Còcaire Fiadhain – a’ rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a’ coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a’ trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Tha Màiri Anna is Liusaidh a’ giollachd dhuircean daraich airson flùr a dhèanamh dhiubh, tha iad a’ lorg balagan fiaclach ann an Loch Aills, agus tha iad a’ dèanamh air Ceann a’ Ghiùthsaich air thòir air measan cùbhraidh nan aiteann. Agus tha iad a’ gabhail cuairt a dh’Eilean Èisdeil, feuch an trus iad sìol milis, blasta Lus nam Buadh agus far a bheil iad a’ beachdachadh air deifir bhuill de theaghlach phlanntrais nan curran.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke – The Wild Cooke – forage for nature’s bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

Broadcaster Cathy Macdonald talks to sons and daughters of the manse, who were brought up during a time when the church had far reaching influence. She speaks to the Rev Iver Martin, who followed in his father’s footsteps and became a minister, and who is now the Moderator of the Free Church of Scotland.
Cathy chats with Jessie Mary Little, daughter of Rev Angus Smith, the well-known minister who protested against Sunday sailings in 1965 and she also talks to Donald John MacAulay, son of the Rev Murdo MacAulay, who describes how faith has had a strong influence on his life. They all share warm-hearted stories about their parents, church services and the camaraderie of communions, creating a portrait of the parishes in which they grew up.

programme.title: Aidan: Balach Beag Muay Thai
programme.desc:
Tha Aidan, a tha deich bliadhna a dh’aois, ag ullachadh airson an t-sabaid às mòtha de bheatha ’s e a’ gabhail pàirt ann an Farpais WBC Muay Thai na Cruinne. Na dhùthaich fhein, Alba, tha fios aige gu bheil e math air sabaid Muay Thai ach ciamar a thèid dha an aghaidh clann bho dùthchannan a tha tòrr nas mòtha? Tha sinn dha leantainn, ag obair gu cruaidh air na sgilean Muay Thai aige, an cois a neach-teagaisg – a mhàthair. Cuideachd, chì sinn mar a tha e ag obair a dh’ionnsaidh a bhith làidir gu leòr airson an fharpais air fad. Cluinnidh sinn bho Aidan ciamar a tha e dol a dheiligeadh ri bhith sabaid an aghaidh clann a dh’fhadaodh a bhith suas ri 35cg, ’s gun esan ach 29cg. Dè sèorsa buaidh a bheir seo air na sabaidean aige?
Aidan, a ten-year-old boy from Scotland, prepares for the biggest fight of his life as he competes in the WBC World Muay Thai festival. In Scotland, he knows that he is a good Muay Thai fighter, but how will he compare to children from much bigger countries?
We follow his journey as he practises his Muay Thai technique with his coach, who is also his mum, as well as working on building his endurance so he will be able to compete in multiple fights. Aidan also discusses his height as he will be competing in the under 35kg weight bracket. At 29kg, will Aidan’s small stature affect the outcome of his fights? Director - Nina Torrance Producer - Maureen MacLeod Producer - Annie Cheape Executive Producer - Phillis Fermer Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid.

programme.title: Golf: Mun Cuairt Alba
programme.desc:
Le còrr air 550 raon-goilf tha Alba cliùiteach mar dhachaigh ghoilf. Tha an sreath 6-pàirt seo a’ gabhail turas air feadh na dùthcha gu na cùrsaichean ainmeil agus na seudan àlainn nach eil cho iomraiteach, a’ fosgladh ar sùilean gu goilf. Cluinnidh sinn bho ghoilfearan sean is òg, fireann is boireann, goilfearan dall is goilfearan ciorramach, agus bho chuid a bhios a' cosnadh beòshlaint à goilf.
An t-seachdain-sa, gabhaidh sinn sgrìob-adhair mu chuairt taghadh de raointean-goilf anns na h- Eileanan an Iar, cluinnidh sinn mu eachdraidh Aisgeirnis ann an Uibhist a Deas, tha Stuart Griffin is Hugh Ross a’ cluich goilf le aon ghàirdean agus cluinnidh sinn an sgeòil aig Club Goilf Shruighlea. Agus tha coidse proifeiseanta Keil Beveridge a’ toirt seachad comhairle na seachdaine airson dòigh-cluiche.
Scotland has over 550 golf courses and is regarded worldwide as the home of golf. This series takes us on a journey around the country to explore some of the well-known courses as well as some of its hidden gems, and opens the door to golf. We hear from golfers young and old, male and female, blind and disabled, and from those who make their living working in golf. We also capture a few tips from the professionals along the way.
In this episode, we take an aerial journey around a selection of golf courses in the Western Isles. We learn about the story of the historic golf course at Askernish in South Uist.
Stuart Griffin and Hugh Ross are one-armed golfers who compete internationally. We catch up with them playing at Stirling Golf Club. And professional coach Keil Beveridge demonstrates his weekly top playing tip.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Expert - Keil Beveridge Expert - Laura Murray Producer - Patricia Macleod Director - Scott Brown Editor - Jonny Craigmile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a’ dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh’ionnsaich i fhèin a’ chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a’ cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th’ air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a’ toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba ’s e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha.Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy will support us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people’s skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds. Presenter - Joy Dunlop Presenter - Calum Maclean Executive Producer - Una McDonald Executive Producer - Calum McConnell Director - Sam Pearce.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc:
Ramsay meets singer Mary Ann Kennedy in Ardgour. Although born in Glasgow, Mary Ann discusses how she has made her home in Ardgour and what that means to her.
As they walk along Cona Glen, Mary Ann opens up about feeling comfortable in her own skin and how the environment has helped her find peace. She chats about her changing relationship with music and what brings her happiness.
San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha.Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri Màiri Anna NicUalraig ann an Àird Ghobhar. Ged a rugadh i ann an Glaschu, innsidh Mairi Anna an luach a tha i cuir air far a bheil i air a dachaigh a steidheachadh.
A ’coiseachd tron Chona Ghleann, fuasglaidh Màiri Anna suas ma beachdan air a pearsa fhèin agus mar a tha an àrainneachd mu chuairt air a cuideachadh gus sìth a lorg. Tha conaltradh ann ma caochladh dhàimh le ceòl agus dè dìreach a tha toirt toileachas dhi.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.sub-title: Spàinn agus Moroco ║ S1E1/4. Spain & Morocco ║ S1E1/4
programme.desc:
Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ dol air turas gus faighinn a-mach mun chrìoch eadar an Spàinn agus Moroco. Ann an Ceuta tha feansa àrd a’ sgaradh Afraga agus an Roinn Eòrpa agus dha mòran is e seo an geata chun na Roinn Eòrpa. Coinnichidh Ramsay ri imrichean a tha air a h-uile càil a tha aca a chuir ann an cunnart is iad a’ dol tarsainn air a’ bhalla an tòir air beatha nas fheàrr. Cluinnidh e bho luchd-còmhnaidh ionadail Ceuta a tha beò fo sgàil teannachadh poilitigeach agus coinnichidh e ri daoine a bhios ag obair gus an fheadhainn as motha a th’ ann an cunnart a chuideachadh.
Ramsay MacMahon goes on a journey to find out about the border between Spain and Morocco. In Ceuta, a high fence separates Africa and Europe and for many, this is the gateway to Europe. Ramsay meets migrants who have risked everything to cross the wall in the hope of a better life. He hears from local residents who live with the political tensions and meets people who work to help the most vulnerable.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Dàna
Scotland's Wild Side
programme.sub-title: Toirbheartan ║ Dàna. S3. ALBAE3/4. Torridon ║ Dàna. S3. ALBAE3/4
programme.desc:
The mountain amphitheatre of Torridon is famed both for its spectacular winter environment and the rock climbing available in summer months. To gain a full understanding of this incredible area, Coinneach Rankin travels there at opposite ends of the year.
With his partner Rori Hawthorn, the pair experience the full range of Scottish weather, access icy summits and enjoy picturesque cragging on an idyllic summer’s day.
Tha cruth-tìre bheanntachail Thoirbheartan cliùiteach an dà chuid son a h-àrainneachd geamhrachail agus an sreap air creig a gheibhear ann as t-samhradh. Gus làn tuigse fhaotainn air an t- àite sònraichte seo, thèid Coinneach MacFhraing ann aig gach ceann den bhliadhna.
Cuide ri a charaid Rori Hawthorn, cuiridh e eòlas air làn caochlaideachd aimsir na h-Alba, ruigidh e bearraidhean deigheach agus thèid e an sàs anns na creagan air latha brèagha ‘sa ghrèin.
In Gaelic with English subtitles. Presenter - Coinneach Rankin Executive Producer - Tony Kearney Executive Producer - Jim Webster Executive Producer - Calum McConnell Director - Hamish MacLeod.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc:
Air a togail san dàrna linn deug ann am meadhan Paris (air an Île de la Cité), aig aon àm b' e Notre-Dame a' chathair-eaglais a b' àirde air thalamh. Tha an t-soitheach aibhseach cloiche seo a' riochdachadh ailtireachd Gotach. Ach tha a seasmhachd a-nise ann an cunnart.
Rinn an teine milleadh air cothromachd an togalaich. Chaidh am mullach a sgrios, còmhla ris a' chliath iongantaich fiodha seo – air a dèanamh de mhìle craobh daraich – 's chaidh a losgadh san teine. Ach fhathast cha do thuit Notre-Dame. Dè as coireach gu bheil i cho làidir? Am measg an sprùillich chaidh iomadh ceangal meatailt a lorg, cuid de mheud iongantach. An robh iad nam pàirt dhen chiad dhealbhadh no nach robh? An gabhadh e a bhith gun do dh'fhuiling Notre-Dame trioblaidean structarail eile tro na linntean?
Leanaidh sinn gu dlùth an luchd-saidheans is na h-ailtirean is iad a' sgrùdadh a' chliath iongantach fiodha is meatailt a bh' air cùl na cloiche. Le cuideachadh bho dhealbhan 3D agus ath-achdachaidhean gheibh sinn tuigse air toiseach an togalaich mhòrail seo.
Built in the 12th century in the centre of Paris (on Île de la Cité), Notre-Dame was once the world's highest cathedral. This gigantic stone structure is the very essence of Gothic architecture. But today, its stability is compromised.
The 2019 fire greatly damaged the building's structure. Its roof was completely destroyed, as well as its incredible wooden frame, made of a thousand oaks, which was swallowed by the flames. Still, Notre-Dame did not collapse. What are the secrets of this exceptional strength? Amongst the wreckage, many metal fasteners were found, some of incredible size. Were they part of the original design or not? Is it possible that Notre-Dame encountered other structural problems throughout the centuries?
We closely follow scientists and architects as they study the impressive skeleton of wood and metal which hid behind the stone. Supported by 3D animations as well as re-enactments, their interventions allow us to grasp the genesis of this monumental structure.
Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles. Narrator - Anna Murray Producer - Seumas Mactaggart Executive Producer - Shona Henderson Executive Producer - Calum McConnell Editor - Innes Macleod.

programme.sub-title: Meal do Naidheachd An-Diugh - Happy Birthday ║ S1E1/6

A dreadful accident takes place on the mill floor that endangers the life of a beloved employee, Old Mary. With the family business in jeopardy, Seumas makes a secret phone call asking for help, but who is he reaching out to and why does he have to keep it secret from his family?
Tha taghaidhean mòra air thoiseach orra aig Muileann MhicSuain, a’ mhuileann chlò Innse Gall a th’ air a ruith le teaghlach MhicSuain. Tha an ùine a’ ruith air ceannard na muilne, Seumas, agus e a’ dèanamh nas urrainn dhà gus a’ ghnìomhachas aige a shàbhaileadh – ach tha cùisean a’ tighinn gu ceann uabhasach ri linn an dòigh-obrach charach aige. Tha tubaist eagalach a’ tachairt air làr na muilne a tha a’ cur beatha tè dhen luchd-obrach, Màiri, ann an cunnart. Le gnìomhachas an teaghlaich fo imcheist, tha Seumas a’ cur a dh’iarraidh cuideachadh – ach cò dhà a tha e a’ faighneachd agus carson a dh’fheumas e a chumail bhon chòrr dhen teaghlach?

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc:
Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann agus a’ faighinn a-mach mu mar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluich cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Rose agus na mialchoin aice, Libby is Marvin. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh coin agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios Rose is na coin a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean.
Eilidh Cormack visits Rose and her beautiful greyhound dogs, Libby and Marvin. We learn how to look after dogs and find out about all the lovely stuff they get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on looking after pets at home; including how best to handle, train and feed them. Presenter - Eilidh Cormack Producer - Donna Murchison Production Manager - Mairi MacKinnon.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc:
Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Mairi NicAonghais a’ leughadh Sid nan Sia Dìnnearan. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Inga Moore agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart.
A bedtime story for young children. Mairi MacInnes reads Sid nan Sia Dìnnearan, written and illustrated by Inga Moore and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart. Actor - Mairi MacInnes.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc:
Tha na Gumbalan uabhasach trang 's iad ri buain na dearc-choille uaine – ach Troig a-mhàin! Chan eil aire-san air na gnothaichean a bha 'n urra ris idir, idir. 'S ann a tha esan a' cur a’ charaidean ann an cunnart!
The Gumbals are very busy, harvesting greenberry - except for Troig! He has lost all interest in what he was meant to be doing. In fact, he puts his friends in danger! Troig/Rìgh - Iain Macrae Bonns - Mischa Macpherson Uilidh/Seonaidh - Lana Beaton Snorg - Derek MacIntosh Glob - Calum MacKinnon Chank - Ruaraidh Munro Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Editor - Phil Reed Producer - Mairi Macleod.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc:
Tha samh grod bho Throig, Bonns is Uilidh nuair a tha iad a' cir geall air a chèile cnuimhean-toilidh ithe - samh cho grod ’s gu bheil an droch fhàileadh a' cur na Bògaisean craicte!
There’s a horrible smell from Troig, Bonns and Uilidh when they bet one another to eat chill-grubs - so awful that the smell sends the Bògaisean doolally! Troig/Rìgh - Iain Macrae Bonns/Merri - Mischa Macpherson Uilidh - Lana Beaton Dùd/Snorg - Derek MacIntosh Glob - Calum MacKinnon Chank - Ruaraidh Munro Executive Producer - Bill Macleòid Producer - May Smart Editor - Phil Reed Producer - Mairi Macleod.

programme.title: Seonaidh
Shaun the Sheep
programme.sub-title: Rùn Bitzer ║ Seonaidh. S4E24/30. Bitzer's Secret ║ Seonaidh. S4E24/30
programme.desc:
Tha an tuathanach a' co-dhùnadh gu bheil an t-àm ann fàs fallain - agus tha e ag iarraidh Bitzer a thoirt a-steach air cùisean. Tha beachd eile aig Bitzer ge-tà agus tha e a' tighinn an àrd le plana dìomhair gus an obair chruaidh a sheachnadh. An dèan an sgeama aige a' chùis aig a' cheann thall?
The farmer decides it is time to get fit and calls on Bitzer to join him. Bitzer has other ideas and comes up with a secret plan to avoid putting in the hard work. Will his scheme catch up with him in the end?

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc:
Aig Coinneamh nam Pàrant, tha Hilda ag ionnsachadh g’ eil creag bhon Chruinneachadh Nàdair aig Dàibhidh neo-àbhaisteach is, ri linn sin, tha 'd uile ann am fìor chunnart
At the parents’ meeting, Hilda learns that one of Daibhidh’s rocks from his nature collection is out of the ordinary. But it puts them all in great danger. Hilda - Mischa Macpherson Mum - Anna Murray Daibhidh (David) - Ellen MacDonald Flòraidh (Frida) - Lauren Macdonald Margie/Ms Hallgrim - Kathleen MacInnes Executive Producer - Bill MacLeod Producer - May Smart Producer - Mairi Macleod Editor - Phil Reed Writer - Alec MacDonald.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc:
Tha oidhche Shathairne tric a’ ciallachadh ‘takeaway’, ach tha na seòid a’ sealltainn dhuinn gun gabh biadh ‘chippy’ a dhèanamh aig an taigh cuideachd. Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh iasg blasta le taois-leanna fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh tiops air am bruich dà thuras. Tha Ùisdean an uairsin a’ dèanamh Scampi agus ‘Clampi” ann an taois tempura le tiops air am bruich trì tursan! Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Coleslaw a thèid còmhla ris agus cuideachd sabhs spìosrach. Gus crìoch a chur air a’ phrògram, tha Ùisdean a’ dèanamh donut reòiteig, le Ruairidh a’ dèanamh sabhs caramail airson a ghabhail còmhla ris.
Saturday nights often mean takeaway dinners, but the lads show us that excellent 'chippy' food can be made at home, too. Ruaridh cooks a tasty beer-battered fish while Uisdean prepares twice cooked chips to go with it. Uisdean then makes Scampi and 'Clampi' in tempura batter accompanied by thrice-cooked chips! Ruaridh creates a coleslaw and a spicy dipping sauce as an addition. Uisdean then makes an ice cream doughnut while Ruaridh cooks a caramel sauce to go with it.
In Gaelic with English subtitles Presenter - Uisdean Macleod Presenter - Roddy Munro Executive Producer - Ishbel Maclennan Production Manager - Mairi Macleod Producer - Kenneth Stewart.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop a’ leantainn oirre ’s i gar toirt tro cheumannan a bharrachd ann a bhith ag ionnsachadh na Gàidhlig. Bidh i a’ dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean làitheil agus, mar thè a dh’ionnsaich na Gàidhlig i fhèin, bheir Joy mìneachadh dhuinn air briathrachas, gràmar is gnathasan-cainnte ann an dòigh a tha furasta a thuigsinn.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh a th’ air Gàidhlig ionnsachadh gu àrd ìre neo a thogadh leis a’ Ghàidhlig air falbh bho sgìrean traidiseanta na Gàidhealtachd, agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a’ toirt sealladh dhuinn air annasan is cuspairean ’s e air chuairt air feadh na dùthcha.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot, ann am pod-chraolaidhean SpeakGaelic air BBC Sounds agus tha na prògraman air fad rin lorg le fo-thiotalan air sianal YouTube SpeakGaelic.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to keep on speaking Gaelic. As in previous series, she introduces and explains usage for words and phrases on everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy will support us through vocabulary, grammar and idiom on topics such as medicine, politics, community and exercise.
Guests include diligent speakers who have embraced the language, and the intrepid Calum Maclean ventures to forgotten corners of Scotland seeking hidden treasures.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot, in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds and with English subtitles on SpeakGaelic’s YouTube channel. Presenter - Joy Dunlop Presenter - Calum Maclean Producer - Donald Macleod Executive Producer - Una McDonald.
